// Optional, file-only public protobuf oracle. No SDK/exporter or Pulse code.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	logs "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/logs/v1"
	metrics "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/metrics/v1"
	traces "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/trace/v1"
	common "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/common/v1"
	metricspb "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/metrics/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protowire"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func msg(n protowire.Number, b ...[]byte) []byte {
	v := bytes.Join(b, nil)
	return protowire.AppendBytes(protowire.AppendTag(nil, n, 2), v)
}
func text(n protowire.Number, s string) []byte { return msg(n, []byte(s)) }
func uintv(n protowire.Number, v uint64) []byte {
	return protowire.AppendVarint(protowire.AppendTag(nil, n, 0), v)
}
func fixed(n protowire.Number, v uint64) []byte {
	return protowire.AppendFixed64(protowire.AppendTag(nil, n, 1), v)
}
func pair(k string, v ...[]byte) []byte { return bytes.Join(append([][]byte{text(1, k)}, v...), nil) }
func stringpair(k, v string) []byte     { return pair(k, msg(2, text(1, v))) }
func resource() []byte {
	return bytes.Join([][]byte{msg(1, msg(1, stringpair("service.name", "wire-fixture")), uintv(2, 7)), msg(1, msg(1, stringpair("resource.second", "retained")), uintv(2, 0))}, nil)
}
func scope() []byte {
	return bytes.Join([][]byte{msg(1, text(1, "wire.scope"), msg(3, pair("scope.first", msg(2, fixed(4, 0x8000000000000000))))), msg(1, text(2, "1.0"), msg(3, stringpair("scope.second", "b")))}, nil)
}

const time uint64 = 1700000000123456789

func number(v uint64) []byte {
	exemplar := msg(5, fixed(2, time), fixed(3, 0x3ff8000000000000), fixed(6, 9))
	return bytes.Join([][]byte{fixed(3, time), fixed(4, 0x3ff8000000000000), fixed(6, v), exemplar}, nil)
}
func ids(value any) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for k, item := range v {
			if k == "traceId" || k == "spanId" || k == "parentSpanId" {
				raw, e := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(item.(string))
				must(e)
				v[k] = hex.EncodeToString(raw)
			} else {
				ids(item)
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, item := range v {
			ids(item)
		}
	}
}
func emit(dir, name string, wire []byte, out proto.Message) {
	must(proto.Unmarshal(wire, out))
	expected, e := (protojson.MarshalOptions{UseEnumNumbers: true}).Marshal(out)
	must(e)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+"-google.json"), expected, 0600))
	var tree any
	must(json.Unmarshal(expected, &tree))
	ids(tree)
	expected, e = json.Marshal(tree)
	must(e)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), expected, 0600))
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".protobuf"), wire, 0600))
	// Public encoder canonicalizes/merges before producing this second wire form.
	canonical, e := proto.Marshal(out)
	must(e)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+"-canonical.protobuf"), canonical, 0600))
}
func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	must(os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700))
	// Same AnyValue array member merges. Different members clear the previous
	// member; returning to the array must not resurrect its earlier elements.
	arr := func(s string) []byte { return msg(5, msg(1, text(1, s))) }
	body := bytes.Join([][]byte{msg(5, arr("discarded")), msg(5, text(1, "also discarded")), msg(5, arr("first")), msg(5, arr("second"))}, nil)
	nested := pair("nested", msg(2, msg(6, msg(1, stringpair("a", "one")))), msg(2, msg(6, msg(1, stringpair("b", "two")))))
	log := bytes.Join([][]byte{fixed(1, time), body, msg(6, nested)}, nil)
	emit(dir, "logs", msg(1, resource(), msg(2, scope(), msg(2, log))), &logs.ExportLogsServiceRequest{})
	span := bytes.Join([][]byte{text(1, "0123456789abcdef"), text(2, "abcdefgh"), text(5, "merged"), fixed(7, time), fixed(8, time+1000), msg(15, text(2, "retained status")), msg(15, uintv(3, 1)), msg(9, nested)}, nil)
	emit(dir, "traces", msg(1, resource(), msg(2, scope(), msg(2, span))), &traces.ExportTraceServiceRequest{})
	// A->B->A oneof selection, followed by merging the same message member.
	metric := bytes.Join([][]byte{text(1, "merged.gauge"), msg(5, msg(1, number(99))), msg(7, msg(1, number(88)), uintv(2, 2)), msg(5, msg(1, number(7))), msg(5, msg(1, number(8)))}, nil)
	emit(dir, "metrics", msg(1, resource(), msg(2, scope(), msg(2, metric))), &metrics.ExportMetricsServiceRequest{})
	literals := []string{"0", "-0", "1", "1.0", "1.000", "1e3", "1E+3", "1e-1", "10e-1", "9223372036854775807", "9.223372036854775807e18", "-9223372036854775808", "-9.223372036854775808e18", "9223372036854775808", "18446744073709551615", "18446744073709551616", "184467440737095516150e-1", "9007199254740993.0", "1.00000000000000000001", "0e1000000", "1e1000000", "1e-1000000", "01", "+1", ".0", "1.", " 1", "1 ", "NaN", "Infinity"}
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	for _, kind := range []string{"int64", "uint64"} {
		for _, literal := range literals {
			quoted, _ := json.Marshal(literal)
			var out proto.Message
			var body []byte
			if kind == "int64" {
				out = &common.AnyValue{}
				body = append(append([]byte(`{"intValue":`), quoted...), '}')
			} else {
				out = &metricspb.HistogramDataPoint{}
				body = append(append([]byte(`{"count":`), quoted...), '}')
			}
			err := protojson.Unmarshal(body, out)
			row := map[string]any{"kind": kind, "literal": literal, "accepted": err == nil}
			if err == nil {
				encoded, e := (protojson.MarshalOptions{EmitUnpopulated: true}).Marshal(out)
				must(e)
				var v map[string]any
				must(json.Unmarshal(encoded, &v))
				if kind == "int64" {
					row["expected"] = v["intValue"]
				} else {
					row["expected"] = v["count"]
				}
			}
			cases = append(cases, row)
		}
	}
	encoded, e := json.Marshal(cases)
	must(e)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "numeric-strings.json"), encoded, 0600))
}
func must(e error) {
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
